utterance_splits.note: 1:00:19 two students at the podium: 'My name is Alex' then 'I'm Emily Byrne, I'm a sophomore at Athens'; the speech that follows (#236, 'currently attending Troy High School') is Alex Smith's

notes: Roll call from the chair: 'Resolution passes 6-0 ... I'm forgetting that Nancy's not here' (39:19) — Philippart absent, six trustees present.
A+B+C are one voice: the chair, split three ways (A 'supported by Ms.' / C 'Alic. Any questions' at 45:44 is one sentence). Vital Anne chairs (forum 2026-09-24: 'currently as a board president').
N = Machesky: the chair asks 'Dr. Machesky?' (1:32:18) and N answers 'Yes, Miss Anne, and thank you, Miss Alic'; frame at 1:32:34 shows a man speaking beside the president's plate.

J = Melton: 'Dr. Melton?' (1:22:16) -> J; J's 19:54 turn ('thank the board for sticking with us', talked to Oakland County Parks staff) is Melissa Prowse, the only Melissa Chris Bunch named as present.

E = Jansen ('I invite Mr. Matt Jansen' 7:14). E/T lines at 21:52-22:10 are Brian, Six Rivers land protection director and Auburn Hills mayor per Bunch ('as Kris mentioned, born and raised in the city of Troy'); surname not spoken, so not added.

G = Trudel ('Mr. Trudel' 43:17); G's 30:37 turn ('this awesome team that Casey and I have had the pleasure to work with') is Principal Ryan Brinks. W = Casey Conaton ('Ryan and I were both new to Smith').

Student reps by name plate (frames 1:11:17, 1:13:57): Landon Ibrahim / Sahibajit Singh; Shyanne Kurzynski / Ahyoung Song. The STT wrote 'Cheyenne Kerszynski'; the plate spelling is used. Miranda spoke for Landon ('since Miranda is our guest' 1:09:05); her surname was not given.

Public commenters as announced by the chair: Tim Hughes (35:08), Walt Cook (57:00, self-identified), Alex Smith (1:00:07; Haupt thanks 'Alex'). C's 'Do the right thing and ban AI' (1:03:20) closes Smith's speech.
V = Karl Schmidt (former board president: 'weird to be standing here talking to all of you', divesting since 2014); Q = Chris Bunch (Six Rivers executive director, lists who could not attend).

D is interjection dust from several people (79 words in 35 turns) and stays unidentified; the other unidentified lines are one-to-three-word strays inside a cluster whose owner was not speaking at that moment.
